Package game.actions

Interface Harvestable

All Known Implementing Classes:
Cauliflower, Crop, Melon, Parsnip, Strawberry, Tomato
public interface Harvestable
Capability interface for Ground that can be harvested by an Actor, either while standing on it or from an adjacent tile. Implementing classes define the effect of a successful harvest: item production, ground replacement, and any crop-specific side effects. Stamina checking is handled by the calling Action, not by this method.

    • canHarvest

      default boolean canHarvest()
      Whether this crop is currently allowed to be harvested. Defaults to true; override for crops that impose a precondition, such as requiring a minimum number of waterings first.
